mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in labor market (PAYEMS growth below 0.1% monthly) and housing sector (HOUST growth below 0.5% monthly) indicates broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is below 0.1% and HOUST growth is below 0.5% monthly, the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeds 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production growth below -1.0% indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth (mo/mo) is below -1.0%, the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) generates immediate positive market sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP growth below -0.5% (qoq) signals an economic recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 quarterly growth is below -0.5%, the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 1000 thousand units) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1000 thousand units, the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
